Chronicle

    An electronic quest for one Warden against the machine

    Obsidian Spire

    Take the Sun, Moon and Star shards from the barrows of the Gloaming Reach, storm the Spire, and kindle its crown before Ser Vael of Frostvale does. If the Gloom fills its track first, nobody wins.

    Drag to turn the board, scroll or pinch to zoom. Keys: Y yes, N no, X next, F fight, L flee, S stay, I ledger, R repeat, E end.

    Chapter I

    The Kindling Road

      How to play

      The Obsidian Spire is waking. Kindle its crown with the three shards of the old sky, the Sun, Moon and Star, before Ser Vael does and before the Gloom fills its track.

      Your turn

      Click a glowing space to ride one road (two with a Swift Steed), or press Stay to remain where you are. In the wilds, staying means making camp and foraging. Wherever you stop, the Spire tells you what happens and asks for your choices on its keypad. After your action your company eats: one provision for every twelve soldiers or part of twelve. Run out and men desert.

      The spaces

      Your keep
      Hearthmoor gathers 4 coin of tithes each round you are away, up to 32. Men-at-arms cost 2 here, provisions 3 for five.
      Market towns
      Sellswords at 3 coin, provisions at 4 for five, and three relics, different in each town.
      Shrines
      Pray for pilgrims to join you (once every three rounds), pay the oracle to learn which shard a barrow hides, or buy a ward that turns aside one wraith, fever or curse.
      Barrows
      Wights hold the antechamber. Beat them and the sigil on the tomb door shows which shard lies below. A Barrow King guards the tomb itself. Win there and the shard is yours. Six barrows hide two shards of each kind.
      The wilds
      Brigands, wolves, wraiths, fog, storms, fever, caches, sellswords, pilgrims, peddlers and omens.
      The Spire
      Sealed until you carry all three shards. Then take the gate from its Sentinels, beat the Ash Warden in the hall, and at the crown repeat the song of kindling note for note on the three sockets. A wrong note costs two of your company, and you may try again.

      Battles

      Each press of Fight is one exchange. The bigger your company against the foe, the likelier you win it. Win and the foe loses several; lose and you lose one, sometimes two against the fiercest. Flee at any time for a provision and the risk of one more loss. If your company is wiped out you are routed: back to your keep with five survivors and half your purse, and the Gloom rises.

      Relics

      • Wraith Lantern: wraiths cannot touch you.
      • Swift Steed: ride two roads a turn.
      • Runed Blade: your company fights a third larger.
      • War Banner: shrug off the first loss in each battle.
      • Cartographer's Map: never lost in fog, storms spoil less.
      • Hearth Charm: fever passes you by.

      The Gloom

      The Spire pulses every second round and the Gloom track rises. At 4 wraiths walk, at 7 prices rise, at 8 the barrow passages are haunted, at 10 Gloom Hounds hunt, at 14 prices soar. When the peg reaches the last hole, the Spire wakes and the chapter is lost.

      The ledgers

      Each Warden's scorecard keeps company, coin and provisions with a tens peg and a units peg, plus holes for relics, the ward and Spire progress, and sockets for shards. Press Ledger to have the Spire read yours aloud, Repeat to see the last message again, and click the picture window to hurry it along.
